task: Epic 23 user stories: approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Stories represent code-shaped work with testable acceptance criteria.
Stories trace to the confirmed design and its business and architecture sources.
Stories distinguish implementation from out-of-scope work and do not claim unobserved effectiveness.

evidence.source: direct_doc_read:Epic 23 acceptance criteria include input validation, numerical contracts, status transitions, determinism, and authority boundaries
direct_doc_read:Epic 23 stories trace to FDD-023 R1-R11 and BRD-023 requirements

direct_doc_read:Epic 23 tests are bounded by concrete acceptance criteria
direct_doc_read:Epic 23 cites its source ADR, BRD, and FDD
direct_doc_read:Epic 23 explicitly labels synthetic checks and out-of-scope work
